title: Housing Appeals Committee, NSW
summary: This page provides information about the Housing Appeals Committee, which helps people appeal decisions made by social housing providers.
who_can_apply: You must have had a decision made by a social housing provider that you wish to appeal.

faqs.q: What is the Housing Appeals Committee?
faqs.a: The Housing Appeals Committee is a body that helps people appeal decisions made by social housing providers.

faqs.q: Who can appeal a social housing provider decision?
faqs.a: Anyone who has had a decision made by a social housing provider can appeal it.

faqs.q: How do I appeal a social housing provider decision?
faqs.a: You can appeal a decision by following the steps outlined for appealing a social housing provider decision.
